description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator class which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It configures the menu screen for performance tracking logs within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, adjusting the screen based on query parameters from the current HTTP request.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the performance tracker log menu in the HRM system, adjusting the display based on user request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu screen for performance tracking logs; switches the screen view based on 'mode' query parameter from the current request.
